_readme: Firestore document ownerData/settings (owner-only; no client can read or write it — only Cloud Functions and the Firebase console). Fill in ownerUids with YOUR Firebase uid (shown in the app: Settings > Account ID) to unlock the owner finance screen and the exchange-rate editor. Remove this _readme key when you paste it in. fxUsdToZmw.updatedAtMs is set by the app's exchange-rate screen; leave it out until then (the screen flags 'never updated').
